pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with sharp edge gradients; patches on the anterior flank are larger and more contiguous, transitioning to smaller, more complex shapes with increased edge angularity towards the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches; nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections; pixel thickness is relatively uniform but displays slight narrowing at posterior junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D contour along the neck and shoulder, characterized by a consistent sawtooth-like silhouette against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized textural disruption on the mid-dorsal ridge, exhibiting a smudged appearance with reduced contrast between dark and light pelage regions.
